response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience and recent involvement in AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators) and agentic workflows, aligning with key technologies like TypeScript and cloud platforms. However, his AI-specific experience (e.g., vector databases, RAG, multi-agent systems) is limited to recent projects and lacks depth in production-grade GenAI systems. His background in web/mobile development and data pipelines is strong but not directly focused on AI-driven solutions.
strengths: Recent hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq
Strong full-stack engineering background with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS, MongoDB)
Proven ability to design and ship production-grade systems, including open-source GISCollective platform
concerns: Limited documented experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks in production
No clear evidence of expertise in LLM performance metrics, optimization, or evaluation pipelines
AI-related work appears tangential (recent) rather than core to his career focus
